# Behavioural Specification: Entropy Source Acknowledge State Machine

## 1. Overview

This module implements a request/acknowledge flow between a consumer and a FIFO. It controls when a requesting consumer is acknowledged and when one FIFO entry is consumed.

The module must:

- Accept requests only while enabled.
- Acknowledge a request only when FIFO data is available.
- Cause exactly one FIFO entry to be consumed for each acknowledgement.
- Wait, if necessary, until FIFO data becomes available.
- Return to its idle state after each completed or cancelled transaction.
- Report an error condition if it enters an undefined operating state.

## 2. Reset Behaviour

On reset, the module must:

- Enter its idle state.
- Deassert the acknowledge output.
- Deassert the FIFO-pop output.
- Deassert the error output.

After reset, the module must remain idle until enabled.

## 3. Disabled Behaviour

While the enable input is deasserted:

- The module must remain in its idle state if it is already idle.
- The module must not issue an acknowledgement.
- The module must not assert the FIFO-pop output.
- The module must ignore request activity.

If the enable input is deasserted while the module is waiting for FIFO data, the module must cancel the pending request and return to idle. In that case, it must not issue an acknowledgement and must not pop a FIFO entry.

If the enable input is deasserted in the same cycle that FIFO data becomes available while waiting, the disable condition takes precedence. The module must return to idle without acknowledging or popping.

If the module is already in its immediate-acknowledge cycle when the enable input is deasserted, that acknowledgement and FIFO-pop must still complete.

## 4. Request Handling While Enabled

### 4.1 Idle, No Request

While enabled and idle, with no request asserted:

- The module must remain in idle.
- No output shall be asserted.

### 4.2 Request with FIFO Data Available

While enabled and idle, when a request is asserted and the FIFO-not-empty input is asserted:

- The module must enter its acknowledge cycle and issue an acknowledgement on the next cycle.
- The acknowledgement must be accompanied by a FIFO-pop output, consuming exactly one FIFO entry.
- After the acknowledge cycle, the module must return to idle.

### 4.3 Request with FIFO Empty

While enabled and idle, when a request is asserted and the FIFO-not-empty input is deasserted:

- The module must not acknowledge immediately.
- The module must enter a wait state.
- The request must remain pending until either FIFO data becomes available or the module is disabled.

## 5. Wait-State Behaviour

While waiting for FIFO data:

- The request input no longer affects the transaction.
- The module must remain in the wait state as long as the FIFO remains empty and the enable input remains asserted.
- When the FIFO-not-empty input becomes asserted while the module is still enabled:
  - The module must issue an acknowledgement.
  - The module must assert the FIFO-pop output.
  - The module must consume exactly one FIFO entry.
  - The module must return to idle.
- If the enable input is deasserted before the FIFO becomes non-empty:
  - The module must return to idle.
  - No acknowledgement shall be issued.
  - No FIFO entry shall be popped.

## 6. Acknowledge and FIFO-Pop Relationship

The module must obey the following rules:

- The FIFO-pop output must only be asserted in a cycle when the acknowledge output is also asserted.
- The module must never pop more than one FIFO entry per acknowledgement.
- The module must never assert the acknowledge output without causing exactly one FIFO entry to be consumed.
- While enabled, if the request input remains asserted and the FIFO continues to have data available, the module may acknowledge repeatedly, consuming one FIFO entry per cycle.

## 7. Error Behaviour

The module must be able to enter a defined error state if it detects any operating state not used for normal operation.

In the error state:

- The error output must be asserted continuously.
- The acknowledge output must be deasserted.
- The FIFO-pop output must be deasserted.
- The module must not respond to requests.
- The enable input must not cause the module to leave the error state.
- The request input must not cause the module to leave the error state.

Once the error state is entered, only reset must be able to return the module to its normal operation.

## 8. Summary of Required Output Behaviour

| Condition | Acknowledge | FIFO Pop | Error |
|---|---|---|---|
| Reset | Deasserted | Deasserted | Deasserted |
| Disabled, idle | Deasserted | Deasserted | Deasserted |
| Disabled while waiting | Deasserted | Deasserted | Deasserted |
| Enabled, idle, no request | Deasserted | Deasserted | Deasserted |
| Enabled, request, FIFO available | Asserted together with FIFO pop | Asserted together with acknowledge | Deasserted |
| Enabled, waiting for FIFO data | Deasserted until data available | Deasserted until data available | Deasserted |
| Error state | Deasserted | Deasserted | Asserted |
